official_title: AI-based solution to detect and mitigate APT malware
description: An investigation of whether semantic representations of system provenance events, combined with a benign-trained autoencoder, can prioritise anomalous behaviour relevant to Advanced Persistent Threats. Detection evidence is preliminary; mitigation is not yet implemented or evaluated.
current_activity: Consolidating the E5 provenance ablation results and preparing the E7 multiple-seed reproducibility study.
next_activity: E7 — repeat selected configurations with seeds 42, 123 and 456 and report mean, standard deviation and individual outcomes.
primary_operating_point: P99 of benign validation reconstruction error
implementation_note: Roadmap activity counts describe implementation progress only. No dissertation completion percentage is estimated.
